name: tori-v2-side
view: side (profile), facing screen-right; cand3 + step-1 fixes (eye highlights, v2 arms: near arm forward over the belly, far arm peeking in front of the chest)
units: px on the 1024x1024 source canvas (y down)
angleConvention: degrees, + = clockwise on screen (same sign as CSS rotate()); L/R = screen left/right; facing right: negative leg / arm angles swing the foot / paw forward (to the right)
transformModel: M(part) = M(parent) . T(dx,dy) . T(a) S(sx,sy) T(-a) . T(pivot) R(deg) T(-pivot); a = scale anchor (default pivot, or an entry of 'anchors'); a child first rotates about its own pivot and then follows its parent. Draw parts as one flat list sorted by z (z interleaves across the hierarchy, e.g. tail behind legs). CSS per part: left=x, top=y, width=w, height=h, transform-origin: -x px -y px, transform = <root> <...ancestors> <part>, each level = translate(dx,dy) translate(ax,ay) scale(sx,sy) translate(-ax,-ay) translate(px,py) rotate(deg) translate(-px,-py). Reference implementation: scripts/v2/step5_rig.py (side: scripts/v2/side/step5_rig.py) (world_matrices / Rig.render).

root.originNote: bottom point under the hips (x = hip centre between the two hip pivots, y = first row below the soles); place this point on the scene ground line
root.heightNote: feet line to the top of the tuft (alpha>=128)

tail.pivotNote: centre of the step-4 tail-root disk (r 50) behind the torso's back edge
tail.limitsNote: +-10: small (2-4 px) corner of the root fill / cream notch at the junction at the extremes; +-8 cleaner.

legFar.pivotNote: centre of the step-4 hip disk (r 48, + a 38 px disk toward the belly front) under the belly
legFar.limitsNote: +-25 (walk). - = foot forward (right). Behind torso and near leg.

legNear.pivotNote: centre of the step-4 hip disk (r 54) under the belly: the leg's top is round about this point
legNear.limitsNote: +-25 (walk). - = foot forward (right). The rounded hip shows as a small round bump at the back silhouette at -25.

armFar.pivotNote: centre of the far arm's rounded shoulder, hidden behind the torso front / acorn (the far arm is drawn behind the torso)
armFar.limitsNote: +-20. Its base is the arm's own rounded top (complete render behind the torso), so no cut base can show; beyond +-20 the paw goes fully behind the belly (+) or up into the acorn (-).

torso.pivotNote: hip centre between the two hip pivots (lean / sway); legs are root children so the feet stay planted
torso.limitsNote: +-5 lean about the hips with the legs planted; children follow.

pendant.pivotNote: top of the acorn stem where it hangs from the collar
pendant.limitsNote: +-10 clean (belly front silhouette continued under the acorn in step 4).

armNear.pivotNote: centre of the rounded shoulder end (step-4), under collar_front: ball-joint-like turn
armNear.limitsNote: +-30 (walk swing). - = paw forward/up (right): at -30 the forearm is level and passes in front of the acorn. The collar-shadow band on the arm top turns with the arm.

collar_front.pivotNote: rigid part of the torso (same pivot, never rotated on its own; limits 0)

tuft.pivotNote: tuft root below the head outline at the centre of the contact span (base hidden behind the head)
tuft.limitsNote: +-5: beyond, a 1-2 px sliver of background opens under the right lobe (tuft +) / the hidden lobe behind the ear peeks out (tuft -).

head.pivotNote: neck: above the collar, inside the step-4 neck fill, under the head's bottom edge
head.limitsNote: +-8: collar fill above the visible collar shows; a faint 1-px original collar-top edge row is visible.

earNear.pivotNote: ear base where the ear's lower-right meets the head (the ear is drawn in front of the head)
earNear.limitsNote: +-15: turning reveals the head's back stripe continued under the ear (step-4 fill).

breath.use: torso scaleY (breathing / squash) anchored at the feet line; children follow; legs are root children so they stay planted

lean.use: body lean / sway = torso rotation about the hip centre (feet stay planted)

headBob.use: head squash (scaleY ~0.97-1.03) anchored at the neck

combined_poses.pose: walk extreme: legNear -25 legFar +25, armNear +20, armFar -15, tail +5
walk rest stride: legs 0, armNear -20, armFar +15, tail -5

walk.formula: t=2*pi*k/8: legNear=-12.5+12.5 cos t, legFar=12.5-12.5 cos t, armNear=-20 cos t, armFar=+15 cos t, root.dy=-6(1-cos 2t)/2, tail=5 cos 2t, head=-1.5 cos 2t, pendant=4 sin t; f0 = drawn rest stride = contact A, f4 = contact B
